title: Find All Anagrams in a String
statement:
Given two strings `s` and `p`, return an array of all the start indices of `p`'s anagrams in `s`.
You may return the answer in any order (but conventionally sorted small to large).
inputFormat:
Line 1: string s.
Line 2: string p.
outputFormat: Space-separated start indices. If none, output an empty line.
constraints:
1 <= s.length, p.length <= 3 * 10^4
s and p consist of lowercase English letters.

starterCode.python:
s = input().strip()
p = input().strip()
